title: mpi: shared-memory transport (rank mailboxes) + runtime/launcher

description:
FEM-appropriate sparse (CSR) and block-sparse matrix types implementing the LinearOperator interface, so FEM systems feed the shared outram-foam-basic-lib Krylov/preconditioner/GAMG stack without being forced into LduMatrix's face-addressed finite-volume layout. Needs element-level scatter/gather into a global sparsity pattern derived from the DoF graph.

Depends on the LinearOperator generalisation.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: Implemented in crates/farrer-park/src/{sparse,operator}.rs plus a NEW module crates/outram-foam-basic-lib/src/linear_operator.rs. CsrMatrix (scatter/gather/spmv/diagonal/asymmetry), CsrPreconditioner {Identity, Jacobi, Ilu0 on the CSR pattern}. The shared contract is LinearOperator {n_rows, n_cols, apply, diagonal, residual} + OperatorPreconditioner, implemented for LduMatrix (FV) and CsrMatrix (FEM), with NEW generic drivers cg_op/gmres_op/bicgstab_op. Purely additive: no existing outram-foam-basic-lib signature or behaviour changed, and a test asserts LduMatrix's LinearOperator::apply is BITWISE identical to its own multiply. outram-foam-basic-lib's 516 lib tests + 18 integration tests still pass.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: Done. sparse.rs: CsrMatrix with element scatter/gather and mesh-pattern assembly, implementing LinearOperator (op-f9ol) so FEM systems drive the shared Krylov layer. Verified: SpMV matches dense, scatter/gather round-trip, mesh pattern accepts every element entry, Jacobi inverts the diagonal, ILU(0) on a dense pattern is an exact solve.

title: Farrer Park: FEM sparse / block-sparse matrix implementing LinearOperator
